intro: Scavenged Goods are miscellaneous pieces of discarded gear and supplies packed into equipment boxes around Deathknell. Newly risen Forsaken recover them to ensure the endless stream of fresh recruits can be armed and clothed.

p: When new Forsaken pull themselves out of the earth in Deathknell's graveyard, they awaken with little more than rotting burial shrouds. Surrounding settlements and kingdoms offer no aid to the undead, leaving them entirely dependent on what they can salvage. Deathguard Saltain coordinates the collection of discarded weapons, tools, and garments cached in supply crates across the village, distributing them directly to the next batch of risen recruits.
